body.zh: 按 7 项清单检查需求文档，只列问题，并标出严重程度。
body.en: Check a PRD against a 7-point checklist; only problems, each with a severity.

prompt.zh: 请按检查清单审这份 PRD，只报告问题。
prompt.en: Review this PRD against the checklist and report issues only.

body.zh: 把几次访谈的痛点聚成主题，附原话和出现次数。
body.en: Cluster pain points from several interviews into themes, with quotes and counts.

prompt.zh: 归纳我指定的用户访谈，区分原话和假设。
prompt.en: Analyse my selected interviews, separating quotations from assumptions.

body.zh: 按用户影响、证据强度、投入成本、战略契合给需求排序。
body.en: Rank requests by user impact, evidence, cost and strategic fit.

question.zh: 帮我比较这些待办需求的优先级。
